title: Quest Sports Tournament 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Lab access, projectors, certificates and volunteer coordination

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 163 attendees for this Sports Tournament, in line with turnout at our previous Sports Tournament events.
We can deliver this Sports Tournament efficiently within INR 16,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
